description: This file contains unit tests for the QuicConnectionContext and related classes/functions in the quiche QUIC implementation, including tests for context switching, nested switching, and threading behavior.

classes.name: TraceCollector
classes.description: A test tracer class that collects trace messages into a vector of strings.

classes.name: FakeConnection
classes.description: A mock connection object that initializes a tracer and provides access to its trace log.

classes.name: TestThread
classes.description: A template class for running a function in a separate thread, derived from QuicThread.

classes.name: QuicConnectionContextTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for QUIC connection context tests.

methods.name: PrintLiteral
methods.description: Overrides QuicConnectionTracer method to record a literal string.

methods.name: PrintString
methods.description: Overrides QuicConnectionTracer method to record a string view.

methods.name: SimpleSwitch
methods.description: Tests context switching with QuicConnectionContextSwitcher and verifies trace collection.

methods.name: NestedSwitch
methods.description: Tests nested context switching and verifies trace collection for outer and inner contexts.

methods.name: AlternatingSwitch
methods.description: Tests alternating context switching across multiple connections in a loop.

methods.name: RunInThreads
methods.description: Runs a specified function in multiple threads concurrently.
